title: 11 Best Employee Experience Platforms UAE & KSA Companies Need in 2027
summary: Discover the 11 best employee experience platforms for UAE and KSA companies in 2027. Compare features, AI capabilities, pricing, and enterprise readiness.
body_markdown:
The right employee experience platform is now a boardroom priority for UAE companies. EX investment is a board-level agenda item at 68% of UAE firms with over 500 employees. Organizations with[structured EX frameworks](https://www.infeedo.ai/hubfs/EX%20Framework.pdf) report 27% lower voluntary turnover.


We've reviewed UAE HR software and HRMS software UAE options, including the best HRMS software in UAE, and compared leading employee experience platform examples. Among these options, inFeedo AI stands out for AI-led listening. This guide breaks down all 11 platforms to help you choose with confidence for 2027.


## 1. inFeedo AI - Best-Suited Choice for AI-Led Employee Listening


Image Source:[inFeedo AI](https://www.infeedo.ai/)


inFeedo AI, built around its AI agent **Amber** , positions itself as a Chief Engagement Officer for organizations that want to listen, act, and retain talent through[predictive people analytics](https://www.infeedo.ai/predictive-people-analytics) instead of static surveys. The platform suits firms evaluating employee experience platforms across the UAE. It draws on nine years of people-science data and agentic AI to interpret employee sentiment at scale.


### inFeedo AI Employee Experience Features and Use Cases


The platform has three connected modules. The **Listening** module supports onboarding, tenure, and lifecycle check-ins, as well as moments-that-matter and custom pulse surveys. It also supports exit and post-exit check-ins, plus anonymous feedback channels. Its People-to-Meet (PTM) feature identifies disengaged or silent employees and recommends priority 1:1 meetings. AI-generated case summaries help managers act faster.


The **Automation** module resolves FAQs and tickets through agentic AI. It categorizes tickets automatically and monitors SLAs through multi-level escalations. The **Communication** module allows HR teams to create campaigns for specific cohorts with rich media. Teams can send these campaigns through email, Slack, WhatsApp, or Microsoft Teams. **Lens AI** , described as an "Omnipresent AI People Scientist," creates instant topic summaries and labels at-risk employees or exit reasons without manual tagging.


### inFeedo AI UAE and KSA Readiness and HRMS Integrations


UAE HR software and HRMS software UAE buyers can use inFeedo AI in 30 languages through its core plan. Advanced tiers support more than 100 languages, which is useful for the bilingual and multinational workforces common in Gulf countries. The platform integrates with existing HRMS systems through API or SFTP. It reaches employees through Email, SMS, Teams, Slack, and WhatsApp, which covers the communication tools that most UAE and KSA enterprises already use.


### inFeedo AI Strengths, Limitations, and Best-Fit Teams


- **Strengths:** PTM can flag potential attrition, while AI-generated action plans and governance controls support HR teams. Controls include hierarchical admin access and keyword alerts for sensitive issues
- **Limitations:** Pricing is quote-based instead of publicly listed, so budget planning requires a sales discussion before commitment
- **Best-fit teams:** HR and people teams at mid-size and large enterprises with 500 to 9,000+ employees, especially those operating across multiple countries. One client has already scaled the platform across seven countries


### inFeedo AI Pricing and Total Implementation Costs


inFeedo AI does not publish fixed pricing. Each module, including Listening, Automation, and Communication, receives a separate quote based on scope, scale, and language requirements. Most enterprise AI tools involve costs beyond licensing. Infrastructure, HRMS integration work, and[change management](https://www.infeedo.ai/blog/ai-adoption-challenges-in-employee-engagement-why-most-companies-struggle-in-2026) to support employee adoption all contribute to the total spend. Organizations that view AI rollout as a one-time purchase often underestimate the ongoing investment needed for data quality and training.


### inFeedo AI Customer Testimonial Evidence to Verify and Pilot Success Criteria


OYO, which has more than 9,000 employees, used Amber to retain 75% of at-risk employees and maintain culture consistency across seven countries. One client reported an[engagement score of 84](https://online.hbs.edu/blog/post/ai-implementation-cost) and automated 98% of routine HR queries with AI. A full contract should follow a pilot with clear measures. Define one measurable outcome, set a usage milestone, and establish a review date, since pilots without agreed success criteria rarely lead to a clear buying decision.


### **inFeedo AI Middle East Customer Stories**


**Petrotec, Qatar (oil and gas, 600+ employees):** Petrotec deployed Amber Listening for a multicultural workforce whose headcount was growing about 15% a year across locations. inFeedo reports a 77% response rate, a 4/5 organization mood score, and 93% of at-risk employees saved.[Read the Petrotec story](https://www.infeedo.ai/customers/petrotec-oil-gas-employee-retention-case-study)


**Sharaf DG, UAE, Oman, Bahrain and Egypt (electronics retail):** Sharaf DG used Amber to connect with 1,500+ employees across four countries and retained 88% of the employees Amber predicted to be at risk.[Case study listing](https://www.casestudies.com/company/infeedo/case-study/sharaf-dg-connects-with-1500-employees-across-uae-oman-bahrain-egypt-retains-88-employees-predicted-at-risk-by-amber)[fidento](https://amber.fidento.com/resources/)


**Mercer, India, Middle East and Africa:** In April 2026, Mercer announced it is integrating Amber into the AI strategy of its Career business across IMEA, with backing from senior leaders at parent group Marsh.[Read the coverage](https://www.peoplematters.in/news/business/mercer-adopts-amber-ai-to-scale-employee-listening-across-imea-49373)


## 2. BambooHR - For Simplifying Onboarding and Employee Self-Service


BambooHR takes a different approach to employee experience than AI-led listening platforms like inFeedo AI. It does not predict attrition through sentiment analysis. Instead, it reduces friction throughout the employee lifecycle and begins on an employee's first day.


### BambooHR Employee Experience Features and Use Cases


The platform's[employee self-service (ESS) portal](https://www.infeedo.ai/blog/build-employee-self-service-portal-that-actually-works) allows staff to update personal details, request PTO, review pay stubs, and complete self-assessments without sending every request to HR. Its onboarding tools use pre-built and customizable templates based on role and work mode. Teams can send pre-onboarding packets and collect e-signatures for tax forms or direct-deposit details. Mitratech powers the I-9 and E-Verify workflows, which submit forms instantly and flag problems early.


A visual progress bar shows each new hire's checklist status. A "Get to Know You" welcome email also helps new employees connect with their teams before day one. The performance tools include 360-degree review cycles, 1:1 meeting features, and an employee community hub for announcements and recognition.


### BambooHR UAE and KSA Readiness and HRMS Integrations


BambooHR supports customers in more than 150 countries through an in-house support team. This matters to HR leaders comparing UAE HR software and HRMS software UAE options that require consistent service quality. The platform offers more than 150 pre-built integrations, such as Checkr and Cronofy, and it syncs employee records, time-off data, and compliance tools in one system.


inFeedo AI supports more than 100 languages and sends reach-outs through WhatsApp and Teams to reach Gulf workforces. BambooHR's integrations focus more on payroll and ATS connectivity than multilingual sentiment listening.


### BambooHR Strengths, Limitations, and Best-Fit Teams


Teams often rate the interface highly for ease of use. One HR reviewer gave it a 9 out of 10 because employees and line managers can handle leave requests and approvals with little effort. Users also praise the 360 Feedback feature and biannual review cycles.


Some parts of the interface feel dated, and PTO tracking may require more clicks than expected. Payroll integrations with systems such as ADP can also need manual troubleshooting. Growing teams with roughly 60 to 1,000 employees report gaps in[talent analytics](https://www.infeedo.ai/people-analytics-guide) and team-design insight because BambooHR focuses on HR administration rather than deeper people intelligence. The platform suits small and mid-sized businesses that want to move away from spreadsheets. It may not meet the needs of large enterprises that manage global, multi-country HR operations.


### BambooHR Pricing and Total Implementation Costs


Companies with more than 25 employees pay per employee each month: AED 37.64 for Core, AED 64.26 for Pro, and AED 91.80 for Elite. BambooHR applies volume discounts automatically. Smaller companies pay flat monthly fees instead: AED 917.99 for Core, AED 1,560.57 for Pro, and AED 2,386.76 for Elite.


Original implementation takes about four weeks and includes the employee rollout. Teams that prefer to configure the platform themselves can choose a self-guided setup option.


### BambooHR Customer Testimonial Evidence to Verify and Pilot Success Criteria


More than 30,000 companies use BambooHR, and the platform has a 4.4 rating from over 5,800 reviews. KIPP Nashville Public Schools reported that[96% of new hires](https://www.bamboohr.com/) described it as the best onboarding process they had experienced. One customer saved AED 257,035.83 each year with pre-built and custom reports. Another saved AED 146,877.62 annually through performance management, while a third saved AED 73,438.81 a year and reduced payroll work by 20 hours each week through automation.


I would request a trial linked to one workflow, such as onboarding completion time, and compare the results against a clear before-and-after baseline before making a commitment.


## [3. Bayzat - For Connecting UAE HR Software with Employee Benefits](https://www.bayzat.com/)


Image Source:[Bayzat](https://www.bayzat.com/)


Bayzat changes the employee experience conversation from feedback loops to the practical realities of work: payroll, insurance, and benefits administration under one roof for GCC businesses.


### Bayzat Employee Experience Features and Use Cases


The platform's[Core HR module](https://www.infeedo.ai/blog/the-essential-fundamentals-of-human-resource-management-2025-guide) automates leave requests, onboarding, offboarding, and attendance tracking. It removes the manual paperwork that often slows HR teams. Payroll runs end-to-end with built-in bookkeeping, and the Insurance Benefits module lets HR add or remove employees from group health coverage in real time. Staff can also access mental health support, online doctor consultations, and pharmacy services. An Automation layer connects workflows, ticketing, and third-party systems. AI features, including the AI Knowledge Hub, AI Reporting, and AI Assistant, answer policy questions and flag workforce trends without manual research. Unlike inFeedo AI, which focuses on predictive listening through Amber, Bayzat's experience layer focuses on self-service access to pay slips, insurance claims, and benefits.


### Bayzat UAE and KSA Readiness and HRMS Integrations


Bayzat automates WPS file generation, gratuity calculations, and end-of-service benefits under UAE labor law. Saudi operations use native GOSI, Mudad, and Qiwa integrations, along with a Saudization dashboard that provides live Nitaqat band visibility. The platform also offers a CCHI-aligned health insurance marketplace. The interface supports English and Arabic and uses Saudi-dialect-aware copy for KSA teams. It connects with Xero, QuickBooks, Oracle NetSuite, and Muqeem, as well as Microsoft SSO, Google SSO, and biometric devices.


### Bayzat Strengths, Limitations, and Best-Fit Teams


- **Strengths:** data-driven reporting, a well-rated mobile app, and responsive customer service
- **Limitations:** slower responses to certain information requests and recruitment integrations that could be stronger, though the platform already includes performance tracking
- **Best-fit teams:** healthcare, real estate, construction, logistics, financial services, and professional services firms that manage HR and benefits in one system


### Bayzat Pricing and Total Implementation Costs


Bayzat's pricing varies by company size and selected modules. Many companies start with the Core HR and Payroll bundle, then add Benefits or Talent Management. Most companies go live within two to four weeks, and the process covers data migration and training.


### Bayzat Customer Testimonial Evidence to Verify and Pilot Success Criteria


FeaturedCustomers lists Bayzat at[4.8 out of 5 across 1,356 ratings](https://softwarefinder.com/hr/bayzat) . Deliveroo reported insurance premium savings and faster claims processing, while Menarini Group unified HR across five countries through the platform.


## 4. peopleHum - For Bilingual Employee Engagement and Performance


Image Source:[peopleHum](https://www.peoplehum.com/)


peopleHum offers a different perspective on the[employee experience platform UAE](https://www.infeedo.ai/en-ae/middle-east-africa) market. Its bilingual engagement tools support workforces that use English and Arabic each day. inFeedo AI relies on Amber's predictive listening to identify disengagement before it leads to attrition. peopleHum takes a wider HR and engagement approach that combines recruitment, performance, and culture tools in one suite.


### peopleHum Employee Experience Features and Use Cases


The platform focuses on continuous performance management, pulse surveys, and goal tracking. Managers can review these areas during regular check-ins instead of waiting for annual review cycles. Recognition tools allow peers and managers to acknowledge contributions as they happen, while the engagement dashboard brings survey responses into one view for HR teams. Recruitment and onboarding modules are part of the engagement suite, so teams can manage hiring and day-to-day performance discussions in one system.


### peopleHum UAE and KSA Readiness and HRMS Integrations


HR leaders comparing UAE HR software and HRMS software UAE options can use peopleHum's[bilingual interfaces](https://www.infeedo.ai/blog/how-to-create-multilingual-surveys-2025) to support Arabic- and English-speaking teams across the Gulf. Standard integrations work with common payroll and communication tools. Regional compliance support is less extensive than platforms built for the region, especially for WPS or GOSI-specific workflows.


### peopleHum Strengths, Limitations, and Best-Fit Teams


- **Strengths:** bilingual engagement surveys, continuous performance reviews, and an all-in-one HR suite that can reduce the need for multiple vendors
- **Limitations:** less specialized in predictive attrition analytics than AI-led platforms such as inFeedo AI, while its regional compliance support falls behind platforms designed for UAE and KSA labor law
- **Best-fit teams:** mid-sized organizations that want recruitment, performance, and engagement tools in one bilingual system instead of deep predictive people analytics


### peopleHum Pricing and Total Implementation Costs


peopleHum usually offers tiered pricing based on company size and selected modules. Recruitment, performance, and engagement features may come bundled or as add-ons. Buyers should include the time needed to configure bilingual content when calculating implementation costs. Translation and localization work can extend the rollout timeline beyond the base subscription.


### peopleHum Customer Testimonial Evidence to Verify and Pilot Success Criteria


Teams evaluating peopleHum against an AI-led option such as inFeedo AI should request a pilot based on a specific engagement metric. Suitable measures include survey completion rates or manager check-in frequency. Pilot results compared with a defined baseline provide a clearer view of actual returns than vendor claims alone.


## 5. Workvivo - For Internal Communication and Workplace Belonging


Image Source:[Workvivo](https://www.workvivo.com/)


Workvivo changes the focus to how connected people feel at work. It centers on internal communication, recognition, and belonging instead of predictive listening or payroll automation. While inFeedo AI focuses on Amber's sentiment analysis, Workvivo uses communication as the starting point for engagement.


### Workvivo Employee Experience Features and Use Cases


Workvivo HQ is the core platform. This AI-native employee headquarters brings together communication, knowledge, and people intelligence. It has features such as AI Compose for faster writing, Livestreams with AI-powered summaries, Auto-Translate for multilingual workforces, Shoutouts and Badges for peer recognition, Say Hi for new joiner introductions, and Knowledge Pages for policy hubs. Seer by Workvivo is the standalone people intelligence product. It manages[employee listening](https://www.infeedo.ai/glossary/continuous-employee-listening) , engagement surveys, and useful analytics, and it can also work as an HQ add-on. HQ Agent adds agentic AI to the platform, allowing employees to search connected systems and complete tasks without changing tools. Chat and Workvivo TV provide up-to-the-minute messaging and digital signage for frontline teams.


### Workvivo UAE and KSA Readiness and HRMS Integrations


Organizations assessing UAE HR software or HRMS software UAE options can use Workvivo's 40+ native integrations with Microsoft Teams, Slack, Google Workspace, Workday, and BambooHR. Teams can connect these integrations within hours. iOS and Android mobile apps, single sign-on, and role-based security come standard across plans. SOC 2 and ISO 27001 certifications support the platform's security controls. Global enterprises such as Bupa, Amazon, Telus, Motherson, Mercedes, and Ryanair already use the platform for their digital employee experience.


### Workvivo Strengths, Limitations, and Best-Fit Teams


Customers typically launch within 2-4 weeks and achieve[90%+ adoption](https://www.workvivo.com/pricing/) with little training. The interface feels familiar to tools that employees already use. Workvivo offers a tailored demo rather than a free trial, and pricing starts at 250 users. This makes it less suitable for very small teams. So, the platform is best suited to mid-size and large organizations with frontline or distributed workers that need a unified communication layer.


### Workvivo Pricing and Total Implementation Costs


Business plans start at[AED 73,438.81 per year](https://www.workvivo.com/pricing/) for 250-2,000 employees, while Enterprise pricing scales separately. Moderate deployments with branding and 1-2 integrations cost AED 36,720-30,000. Complex deployments with multiple system integrations can reach AED 110,160-75,000+ over 3-4 months. A 200-person organization should budget AED 110,158.21-275,395.53 for the first year once setup, training, and integrations are included.


### Workvivo Customer Testimonial Evidence to Verify and Pilot Success Criteria


Enterprise adopters such as Bupa and Ryanair support Workvivo's reported 90%+ adoption standard across its customer base. I would still request a demo focused on one communication workflow before signing because no free trial is available.


## 6. QuestionPro Workforce - For Employee Surveys and Feedback Analysis


Image Source:[QuestionPro](https://www.questionpro.com/)


QuestionPro Workforce turns employee experience into measurable data. It maps survey responses into immediate dashboards that cover the employee journey from onboarding to exit. InFeedo AI takes a different approach through Amber's continuous listening instead of periodic pulse checks.


### QuestionPro Workforce Employee Experience Features and Use Cases


The platform's[employee survey software](https://www.infeedo.ai/employee-survey/employee-survey-tools-choosing-the-right-employee-survey-vendor-for-your-organization) gathers feedback through pulse surveys and 360-degree reviews. It then sends the data to TextAI for sentiment analysis and Smart BI dashboards for reporting, both of which come with the Research Suite tier. Action-planning tools turn survey responses into trend data on participation rates and sentiment changes. Recognition and communication tools support day-to-day engagement. Built-in retention and churn modules track departures against survey sentiment and extend measurement across the employee lifecycle, from hire to exit.


### QuestionPro Workforce UAE and KSA Readiness and HRMS Integrations


QuestionPro uses regional data centers for teams with more than five users. This matters to UAE and KSA organizations that must manage data residency alongside HRMS software UAE requirements. Logic-based integrations and Google Spreadsheets connectivity support standard HR technology stacks. Its regional compliance coverage for Gulf labor law is narrower than platforms built for the region. QuestionPro serves[5.3 million users](https://www.questionpro.com/survey-software-comparison/) worldwide, which gives Gulf-based HR teams confidence in the platform's stability.


### QuestionPro Workforce Strengths, Limitations, and Best-Fit Teams


QuestionPro's main strength is its survey and feedback depth. Customizable reporting dashboards support this strength, as does its founder-led, debt-free model and month-to-month contracts. G2 rates the platform 4.5 out of 5. Advanced features such as communities and qualitative research tools have a learning curve. They are also available only through Research Suite's custom pricing. InFeedo AI's Amber flags at-risk employees before survey cycles begin, while QuestionPro relies on structured feedback collection rather than predictive alerts. Enterprise organizations that need measurement and deep analytics are a strong fit, as are mid-sized HR departments that run engagement surveys separately from retention tools.


### QuestionPro Workforce Pricing and Total Implementation Costs


Pricing starts free for up to 200 responses per survey. Plans then move to AED 363.52 per user each month for 25,000 annual responses. Teams with five or more users handling 100,000 annual responses pay AED 304.77 per user each month. Research Suite has custom pricing for ten or more users. Team Edition has 100,000 responses per user each year, or 500,000 yearly with a five-user minimum. Implementation is included, and there is no setup fee.


### QuestionPro Workforce Customer Testimonial Evidence to Verify and Pilot Success Criteria


QuestionPro has answered more than 10 billion questions throughout its platform's history. This volume suggests broad survey reliability. A pilot should begin with a request for response-rate measurements from a comparable deployment. Teams should also set a clear improvement target because scale alone does not confirm whether the platform suits a specific Gulf workforce.


## [7. Culture Amp - For Connecting Employee Feedback with Culture Improvement](https://www.cultureamp.com/)


Image Source:[Culture Amp](https://www.cultureamp.com/)


Culture Amp handles[employee experience](https://www.infeedo.ai/employee-experience) through research-backed surveys and performance templates, rather than the continuous predictive listening that inFeedo AI's Amber provides between formal review cycles.


### Culture Amp Employee Experience Features and Use Cases


Survey reporting expresses the highest- and lowest-scoring questions against previous results and selected standards. It prompts reflection before action planning begins. Culture Amp's People Scientists rebuilt its performance review templates around a four-point rating scale based on a study of more than 150 review cycles. The templates also use self-reflection with peer and upward feedback. Wellbeing support has four Camper Refresh Days each year and unlimited emergency leave for urgent personal situations.


### Culture Amp UAE and KSA Readiness and HRMS Integrations


The platform operates through global hubs and supports remote or hybrid work. Follow-the-sun customer coverage across time zones can extend working hours for distributed teams, which Gulf HR leaders managing multinational staff should consider. Culture Amp supports more than 6,000 customers worldwide. That scale does not match the 100+ language coverage that inFeedo AI offers for UAE and KSA workforces when teams compare employee experience platform options.


### Culture Amp Strengths and Limitations for Best-Fit Teams


The platform's strength is[standard reporting](https://www.infeedo.ai/glossary/employee-benchmarking) and science-backed review templates. Its biggest problem is its focus on sentiment rather than detailed team-level work data. This leaves engagement insights disconnected from recruitment and development systems. A late-2025 shift toward AI reduced headcount and increased workload pressure on the remaining teams. Decentralized decision-making also creates coordination overhead and lengthens cycles. Some users report losing review drafts after a submit-button timeout glitch. Culture Amp suits organizations that run structured annual survey cycles better than teams that want the daily predictive alerts that inFeedo AI's Amber already provides.


### Culture Amp Pricing and Total Implementation Costs


Culture Amp does not publish pricing, so budgeting requires a direct conversation with sales. Rollout plans should also account for manager training on sharing qualitative feedback separately from numeric ratings.


### Culture Amp Customer Testimonial Evidence to Verify and Pilot Success Criteria


Culture Amp's base of more than 6,000 customers worldwide provides a long deployment history to reference. Before a pilot, I would link one review cycle to a measurable completion-rate target because users have repeatedly reported lost drafts during submission.


## [8. 15Five - For Manager Check-Ins and Continuous Feedback](https://www.15five.com/)


Image Source:[15Five](https://www.15five.com/)


15Five turns[manager-employee conversations](https://www.infeedo.ai/employee-feedback-guide) into a structured, recurring habit instead of leaving check-ins to each manager's discretion. This differs from inFeedo AI's Amber, which provides always-on listening for enterprises evaluating an employee experience platform across the UAE.


### 15Five Employee Experience Features and Use Cases


The platform focuses on weekly check-ins, where employees answer brief reflection prompts before 1-on-1 meetings. Managers receive context before the conversation begins. Objectives and key results (OKR) tracking works with performance reviews and engagement surveys, keeping goal progress and sentiment data in one dashboard instead of separate spreadsheets. Recognition tools allow peers to acknowledge wins immediately and reinforce check-in habits between formal reviews.


### 15Five UAE and KSA Readiness and HRMS Integrations


HR teams evaluating UAE HR software or HRMS software UAE options can connect 15Five with common HRIS and communication tools. The platform syncs performance data without requiring managers to use a separate system to track conversations.


### 15Five Strengths, Limitations, and Best-Fit Teams


The platform's main strength is its ability to create a consistent manager cadence. It offers less depth in[predictive attrition flagging](https://www.infeedo.ai/blog/employee-attrition-prediction-metrics) than inFeedo AI. Mid-sized companies that want structured 1-on-1 habits are the best fit.


### 15Five Pricing and Total Implementation Costs


Pricing follows tiers based on the selected modules. Setup time increases with manager training needs.


### 15Five Customer Testimonial Evidence to Verify and Pilot Success Criteria


Teams should request check-in completion rates from one manager's team before piloting to establish a baseline.


## 9. Lattice - For Aligning Performance and Career Development


Image Source:[Lattice](https://lattice.com/)


Lattice focuses the employee experience conversation on performance and career growth. It pairs daily habits such as 1:1s and weekly updates with a personal AI Agent that answers policy and career questions. This approach differs from the predictive attrition flagging that inFeedo AI's Amber already provides to enterprises using an[employee experience platform](https://www.infeedo.ai/blog/best-employee-experience-platforms-2026) across the UAE.


### Lattice Employee Experience Features and Use Cases


The platform combines Performance Reviews with Talent Reviews, PIPs and Succession Planning. It also includes Goals & OKRs, continuous Feedback, and Q&A Boards that support transparent conversations. AI-powered insights support engagement surveys, while Compensation tools arrange pay reviews with budget requirements. The mobile app supports check-ins, goal tracking and recognition on iOS and Android.


### Lattice UAE and KSA Readiness and HRMS Integrations


Lattice connects with Workday, Slack and Jira. It syncs feedback, praise and review notifications within existing channels. Lattice is discontinuing its HRIS and payroll products after its Workday partnership. Payroll access ends on March 31, 2026, while HRIS access ends on July 31, 2026.


### Lattice Strengths, Limitations, and Best-Fit Teams


Lattice’s strength is its focus on daily performance habits and OKR arrangement. Its narrower product scope after the HRIS sunset is a limitation. It suits enterprises that already use Workday and want to add performance management.


### Lattice Pricing and Total Implementation Costs


Lattice does not publish pricing. Existing customers receive discounts on the Lattice talent suite.


### Lattice Customer Testimonial Evidence to Verify and Pilot Success Criteria


GoCardless[raised review participation from 62% to 100%](https://lattice.com/) . VantageWest reduced attrition by 27%, while USAirtours increased sales by 20%.


## 10. PeoplesHR - For Connecting Employee Experience with Regional HCM


Image Source:[Ensaan Technologies](https://ensaantech.com/)


PeoplesHR shifts the conversation to workforce data at scale and pairs payroll and time records with talent data through an AI layer called **Lexi** . This approach contrasts with the Amber-led predictive listening that inFeedo AI uses for enterprises assessing an employee experience platform across the UAE.


### PeoplesHR Employee Experience Features and Use Cases


Lexi answers questions about headcount, turnover, and overtime risk directly from PeoplesHR data. It also flags attendance patterns and performance gaps at the team level. Employees can ask about leave balances, payslips, and missing records through text or voice on desktop or mobile devices.


### PeoplesHR UAE and KSA Readiness and HRMS Integrations


The platform uses a modern API architecture with pre-built connectors and low-code partnerships. It serves 1,700+ companies in 40+ countries and supports 1.5M+ users over 29+ years. PeoplesHR also has a Dubai office that supports regional HRMS software UAE buyers directly.


### PeoplesHR Strengths, Limitations, and Best-Fit Teams


PeoplesHR's strength is regulatory compliance automation across jurisdictions. G2 lists implementation at 4 months and[ROI at 7 months](https://www.trustpilot.com/review/peoplehr.com?page=5) . Trustpilot reviewers reported issues with billing and offboarding responsiveness.


### PeoplesHR Pricing and Total Implementation Costs


PeoplesHR now offers three packages, and buyers can use an ROI calculator before purchase.


### PeoplesHR Customer Testimonial Evidence to Verify and Pilot Success Criteria


People's Bank Sri Lanka and Tradco Africa cite smoother multi-country payroll rollouts as proof points.


## 11. Qualtrics EmployeeXM - For Enterprise Employee Experience Analytics


Image Source:[G2](https://www.g2.com/)


Qualtrics EmployeeXM closes the feedback-to-action loop by combining experience data (X-data) with operational data (O-data), including attrition and performance, in a single system.


### Qualtrics EmployeeXM Employee Experience Features and Use Cases


The People Engage SKU includes unlimited engagement, pulse, and ad hoc research surveys. People Lifecycle tracks onboarding, promotions, returns from leave, and exit milestones, along with candidate experience surveys. Continuous Employee Listening processes unstructured data from emails, chats, tickets, online reviews, and voice calls. Qualtrics measures this data as Interactions and allocates 10 Interactions per purchased Employee. Text iQ interprets sentiment in open-ended responses, while Manager Assist provides coaching recommendations.


### Qualtrics EmployeeXM UAE and KSA Readiness and HRMS Integrations


Deep HRIS connections, open APIs, and SAP SuccessFactors integration can trigger surveys at recruiting, learning, and onboarding touchpoints. Qualtrics relies on API-based setup rather than native regional compliance tools. In contrast, inFeedo AI supports more than 100 languages and delivers surveys through WhatsApp for Gulf workforces.


### Qualtrics EmployeeXM Strengths, Limitations, and Best-Fit Teams


CrossXM Analytics connects employee and customer data to provide broader insight. The platform has API rate limits of 3,000 requests per minute and does not offer a sandbox environment. It suits large enterprises that need cross-functional analytics.


### Qualtrics EmployeeXM Pricing and Total Implementation Costs


Implementation takes about three months on average. ROI typically comes after around 20 months, with an average discount of 17%.


### Qualtrics EmployeeXM Customer Testimonial Evidence to Verify and Pilot Success Criteria


The State of Iowa's centralized program improved engagement and productivity through feedback loops that led to action. The[20-month ROI](https://www.applytosupply.digitalmarketplace.service.gov.uk/g-cloud/services/556000838516987) timeline may make inFeedo AI's Amber a faster alternative for teams seeking measurable retention results sooner.


## Conclusion


Each platform on this list addresses a different part of the employee experience, from onboarding and benefits to surveys and career growth. The choice comes down to whether a team needs administrative convenience or predictive insight that helps prevent attrition.


inFeedo AI stands out here through Amber’s nine years of people science data, support for 100+ languages, and results such as OYO’s 75% retention save across seven countries. Request a scoped pilot with one measurable outcome and a set review date before signing. That step separates a confident decision from a costly guess.


## Key Takeaways


Choose an employee experience platform that matches your workforce needs, regional requirements, and measurable business outcomes.


- Match the platform to your priority: AI listening, HR administration, benefits, communication, surveys, performance, or enterprise analytics.
- Prioritize UAE/KSA readiness: verify Arabic support, WPS/GOSI/Qiwa compliance, data residency, and integrations with your existing HRMS and communication tools.
- Use inFeedo AI for predictive, multilingual employee listening; Amber identifies disengagement early and supports action across 100+ languages and Gulf-friendly channels.
- Budget beyond licensing: include integrations, data migration, bilingual configuration, manager training, change management, and ongoing data-quality work.
- Run a scoped pilot before committing. Define one outcome—such as reduced turnover, faster onboarding, or higher check-in completion—and review results on a fixed date.


## FAQs


**Q1. Which employee experience platform is best for companies in Saudi Arabia?**
It depends on your priorities. inFeedo AI suits multilingual, AI-led employee listening, while Bayzat supports Saudi HR operations with GOSI, Mudad, and Qiwa integrations.


**Q2. What are five HR and employee experience platforms worth comparing in the UAE?**
Consider inFeedo AI for employee listening, BambooHR for onboarding, Bayzat for HR and benefits, peopleHum for bilingual engagement, and PeoplesHR for regional workforce management.


**Q3. Which platform is a good choice for employee recognition?**
Workvivo offers Shoutouts and Badges for peer recognition alongside internal communication tools. For recognition combined with regular manager check-ins, 15Five is another option.


**Q4. What should UAE and KSA businesses check before choosing a platform?**
Verify Arabic support, data residency, HRMS integrations, and relevant local compliance features, such as WPS or GOSI support. Check that employees can access it through their usual communication channels.


**Q5. How can companies test an employee experience platform before committing?**
Request a focused pilot with one measurable goal, such as faster onboarding or higher survey participation. Set a starting baseline, a usage target, and a review date to assess results.
